title: Proton pump inhibitors suppress absorption of dietary non-haem iron in hereditary haemochromatosis
authors: Hutchinson C, Geissler CA, Powell JJ, Bomford A
population: Patients homozygous for HFE C282Y: 7 in a case review of maintenance phlebotomy before and during PPI use and 14 phlebotomised patients in a test-meal study before and during 7 days of lansoprazole 30 mg or omeprazole 20 mg
result: Blood removed annually fell from 2.5 L (SE 0.25) before to 0.5 L (SE 0.25) during PPI use (p < 0.001; mean 6.1 and 3.8 years). Seven days of a PPI reduced absorption of non-haem iron (14.5 mg) from a test meal: recovery of administered iron at peak serum iron 20.5% (SE 3.2) against 11.0% (SE 2.0); peak serum iron 13.6 against 6.1 µmol/L (all p < 0.01).
